---
title: "Practical workflows"
description: "Exact validated analyses and shorter reusable sblrbench templates."
---

`sblrbench` offers two complementary forms of runnable analysis:

- **Exact analyses** expose each study's complete validated design and call the
  shared runner without duplicating simulation, fitting, checkpoint, or
  extraction internals.
- **Reusable templates** are shorter starting points for replacing data,
  scenarios, methods, or outputs while keeping the same framework contracts.

| Workflow | Exact analysis | Reusable template | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fine-mapping | [Study 01 analysis](studies/01_finemapping/analysis.R) | [Fine-mapping template](inst/templates/finemapping-analysis.R) | Validated |
| Prediction | [Study 02 analysis](studies/02_prediction/analysis.R) | [Prediction template](inst/templates/prediction-analysis.R) | Validated |
| Parameter estimation | [Study 03 analysis](studies/03_parameter_estimation/analysis.R) | [Parameter-estimation template](inst/templates/parameter-estimation-analysis.R) | Validated |
| Convergence assessment | [Study 04 analysis](studies/04_convergence/analysis.R) | [Convergence template](inst/templates/convergence-analysis.R) | Validated |
| LD-operator analysis | [Study 05 analysis](studies/05_ld_operator/analysis.R) | [Operator template](inst/templates/operator-analysis.R) | Validated |
| Annotation-informed models | [Study 06 analysis](studies/06_annotation_models/analysis.R) | [Annotation template](inst/templates/annotation-analysis.R) | **V1 failed/preserved; v2 scaffolded/unrun** |

## Choosing a profile and mode

- `profile = "workshop"` uses reduced settings for learning, integration
  checks, and workflow development. It is **not evidence for method-performance
  claims**.
- `profile = "benchmark"` resolves the registered scientific coordinates and
  controls used by the corresponding validation design.
- `validate_only = TRUE` validates provenance, coordinates, methods, controls,
  and output contracts without fitting.
- `resume = TRUE` reuses only compatible checkpoints under the shared identity
  rules.

```r
library(sblrbench)

spec <- read_benchmark_spec("studies/02_prediction/spec.R")

result <- run_benchmark(
  spec,
  output_dir = "results/local/example",
  profile = "workshop",
  resume = TRUE
)
```

Use `validate_only = TRUE` first when inspecting a new or modified design.
Workshop output is local working material, not a reference capsule.

## Fine-mapping

**Use it for:** posterior marker prioritization, causal ranks, and cumulative
PIP credible sets within explicit loci.

- [Exact analysis](studies/01_finemapping/analysis.R) · [specification](studies/01_finemapping/spec.R) · [validated report](studies/01_finemapping/report.qmd)
- Key outputs: [marker metrics](results/reference/01_finemapping/current/marker_metrics.csv) and [credible-set metrics](results/reference/01_finemapping/current/credible_set_metrics.csv)
- `sblr` references: [`make_credible_sets()`](https://github.com/psoerensen/sblr/blob/02e8c74baa906e83c4a08d42a9cc6339b4e81072/man/make_credible_sets.Rd) and [`plot_posterior()`](https://github.com/psoerensen/sblr/blob/02e8c74baa906e83c4a08d42a9cc6339b4e81072/man/plot_posterior.Rd)
- **Validation status:** completed Study 01; conclusions apply to its separated-locus design.

## Prediction

**Use it for:** leakage-controlled train/test prediction, genetic-value
recovery, calibration, and matched BED/CSR comparisons.

- [Exact analysis](studies/02_prediction/analysis.R) · [specification](studies/02_prediction/spec.R) · [validated report](studies/02_prediction/report.qmd)
- Key outputs: [prediction metrics](results/reference/02_prediction/current/prediction_metrics.csv) and [paired comparisons](results/reference/02_prediction/current/paired_comparison_summary.csv)
- `sblr` references: [`stblr_bed()`](https://github.com/psoerensen/sblr/blob/02e8c74baa906e83c4a08d42a9cc6339b4e81072/man/stblr_bed.Rd) and [`stblr_csr()`](https://github.com/psoerensen/sblr/blob/02e8c74baa906e83c4a08d42a9cc6339b4e81072/man/stblr_csr.Rd)
- **Validation status:** completed Study 02; workshop settings do not reproduce its performance evidence.

## Parameter estimation

**Use it for:** posterior recovery of variance components, heritability,
active probability, and registered derived quantities.

- [Exact analysis](studies/03_parameter_estimation/analysis.R) · [specification](studies/03_parameter_estimation/spec.R) · [validated report](studies/03_parameter_estimation/report.qmd)
- Key outputs: [estimand registry](results/reference/03_parameter_estimation/current/estimand_registry.csv), [parameter estimates](results/reference/03_parameter_estimation/current/parameter_estimates.csv), and [recovery summary](results/reference/03_parameter_estimation/current/parameter_recovery_summary.csv)
- `sblr` reference: [`summarise_posterior()`](https://github.com/psoerensen/sblr/blob/02e8c74baa906e83c4a08d42a9cc6339b4e81072/man/summarise_posterior.Rd)
- **Validation status:** completed Study 03; five replicates support descriptive rather than precise coverage claims.

## Convergence assessment

**Use it for:** true-chain R-hat, ESS, MCSE, burn-in stability, and fixed-setting
validation. Posterior means and final states are not trace substitutes.

- [Exact analysis](studies/04_convergence/analysis.R) · [specification](studies/04_convergence/spec.R) · [validated report](studies/04_convergence/report.qmd)
- Key outputs: [diagnostics](results/reference/04_convergence/current-selection/convergence_diagnostics.csv), [burn-in stability](results/reference/04_convergence/current-selection/burnin_stability.csv), and [recommendations](results/reference/04_convergence/current-selection/method_recommendations.csv)
- `sblr` reference: [single-trait documentation](https://psoerensen.github.io/sblr/)
- **Validation status:** completed Study 04 for its registered scalar quantities and tested settings.

## LD-operator analysis

**Use it for:** deterministic operator identities, spectral retention,
low-rank/block approximations, recovery, convergence, runtime, and storage.

- [Exact analysis](studies/05_ld_operator/analysis.R) · [specification](studies/05_ld_operator/spec.R) · [operator design](studies/05_ld_operator/operator-design.R) · [validated report](studies/05_ld_operator/report.qmd)
- Key outputs: [deterministic identities](results/reference/05_ld_operator/current/deterministic_identity_summary.csv), [prediction metrics](results/reference/05_ld_operator/current/prediction_metrics.csv), and [SBayesR operator summary](results/reference/05_ld_operator/current/sbayesr_operator_summary.csv)
- `sblr` reference: [`stblr_csr()`](https://github.com/psoerensen/sblr/blob/02e8c74baa906e83c4a08d42a9cc6339b4e81072/man/stblr_csr.Rd)
- **Validation status:** completed integrated Study 05; it establishes no universal sparsity, block, or retained-rank policy.

## Annotation-informed models

**Use it for:** the completed matched BayesR/BayesRC and SBayesR/SBayesRC
annotation validation, offline estimability analysis, and reporting derived
annotation probability functions.

- [Exact gated analysis](studies/06_annotation_models/analysis.R) · [offline estimability analysis](scripts/run_study06_estimability.R) · [specification](studies/06_annotation_models/spec.R) · [annotation design](studies/06_annotation_models/annotation-design.R) · [final conclusion](docs/studies/study06_final_conclusion.md) · [report](studies/06_annotation_models/report.qmd)
- Current evidence: [final decision](results/reference/06_annotation_models/final_decision.json), [cross-implementation comparison](results/reference/06_annotation_models/final_cross_implementation_comparison.csv), and [hierarchy summary](results/reference/06_annotation_models/final_hierarchy_of_evidence.csv). The [prespecified v1 stop capsule](results/reference/06_annotation_models/current-stop/README.md) remains historical evidence.
- `sblr` references: [`stblr_bed()`](https://psoerensen.github.io/sblr/reference/stblr_bed.html) and [`stblr_block_eigen()`](https://psoerensen.github.io/sblr/reference/stblr_block_eigen.html)
- **Validation status:** **closed at EST-R2**. Probability/ranking functions and
  SNP inference are stable; precise annotation-contrast magnitudes remain
  uncertain. The official qualifier is EST-R5, and standard same-posterior
  continuous-alpha sampler development is closed at PMA-R3. No additional
  Study 06 scientific fit is required.

See the [Framework](framework.qmd) for execution and output responsibilities,
and [Reproducibility](reproducibility.qmd) for the distinction between local
results and reviewed reference capsules.
